summary: Every cover letter and interview question set is now saved with its application as a version you can reopen, compare or delete (#2492). Optional guidance steers a draft's emphasis, tone, length and addressee (#2511). Cover letters follow a 250 to 350 word brief, and a Writing check flags sentences with common machine-writing habits; it is not an AI detector (#2517). You can pick Sonnet or the cheaper Haiku, each shown with its estimated cost (#2518), and paste up to three of your own texts so drafts copy how you write (#2519). Each paragraph can be edited and saved as a free new version; numbers no cited fact states are flagged, not refused (#2520). A saved draft downloads as Word or PDF with the CV templates, Modern by default (#2522).
knownLimitations: The research brief before drafting (#2482) waits on the choice of a web search provider, and the second critic pass for machine-sounding sentences (#2514) is not built yet. Drafting still needs DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude route on staging. Beta invites have no routes or screen yet, and the spend pool is off unless configured. Agents cannot approve or export, and saved drafts are not yet reachable from agents. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The local-first desktop has no career interview or Prepare panel.
